# Figure restoration fixtures

`compound-figures.pdf` is a deterministic synthetic PDF used by the figure
restoration tests. It is generated by `scripts/generate-figure-fixtures.mjs`
with Helvetica text, vector panels, and a small embedded image XObject. The
fixture contains no downloaded or copyrighted material and carries no license
restriction beyond the repository license.

`compound-figures.expected.json` records the normalized page geometry and
expected panel counts. Coordinates use a 0-1000 display cropbox frame, with
the origin at the top left after PDF.js rotation and user-unit conversion.
Cases cover regular 2x2 and 4x4 grids, a missing cell, spanning and irregular
panels, independent figures, captions above the figure, continued pages,
rotations, a non-zero cropbox, a non-default user unit, scan-only content, and
an intentionally uncertain panel.

The scan-only page is deliberately rasterized from the same fixed vector scene
to exercise the no-text-layer fallback. It contains panel fills, borders, axes,
arrows, labels, an inset bitmap, a caption, and body text. The provider fixture
still supplies bounded layout evidence, so the complete panel region can be
restored without consulting a PDF text layer; the caption and body remain
outside the crop and searchable in Markdown.
